sourceText.he: לֹא יִמְכּוֹר בְּרָחוֹק כּוּ׳. מְנָא הָנֵי מִילֵּי? דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ״ — יַד עַצְמוֹ, שֶׁלֹּא יִלְוֶה וְיִגְאַל.

positions.claim: one may not sell a distant field to redeem a near one, sell a poor field to redeem a good one, borrow in order to redeem, or redeem by halves
׳and he prospers׳ restricts redemption to the redeemer׳s own means, excluding borrowing
